title: step-solver widget params
description: Per-question configuration for the step-solver answer-producing widget (GSV-2). The student solves the `prompt` equation/expression one line at a time; each line is checked for algebraic equivalence to the line above by the in-sandbox deterministic engine (a port of `apps/core/algebra.py` — never AI), showing live ✓/✗. The student's final line becomes their answer via reportValue, scored by the existing per-subpart grader.

prompt.description: The starting equation or expression shown as the first (fixed) line, e.g. "2x + 1 = 7" or "3(x + 2)". The student rewrites it step by step below. Defaults to "x + 1 = 2" if omitted.

label.description: Optional instruction rendered above the steps (e.g. "Solve for x, one step per line").

maxLines.description: Maximum number of student step lines (excluding the fixed prompt line). Default 8.
